text:
maria_finance: Heads-up — AegisRetail (cust AG-0042) flagged a Feb invoice overcharge of $12,400. Looks like our hourly meter aggregator double-counted deltas during 2026-02-28 00:00-06:00. I think this qualifies for a one-off credit. Need RevOps + CFO sign-off since amount > $10k. Details + SQL below.
jake_acct: Ugh. AM already escalated. They're asking for the full credit and a written concession. Can we confirm root cause and provide a timeline?
sam_revops: @maria_finance can you paste the query and the raw rows? Need to verify billed tokens vs true ingestion. Also what remedy are you proposing: full credit or prorated?
maria_finance: Proposed remedy: one-off invoice credit of $12,400 and a patch to the aggregator to drop duplicate deltas. Draft credit memo here: https://redwood.docs/internal/credits/AG-0042-crew
SQL snippet:
```sql
SELECT hour, sum(report_tokens) as reported, sum(ingested_tokens) as ingested
FROM billing.hourly_usage
WHERE customer_id='AG-0042' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-28' AND '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;
```
Raw rows show repeats for 00:00 and 01:00 (two identical rows per hour).
leo_cfo: @sam_revops @maria_finance quick risk check — if we approve full credit, any churn or precedent concerns? Need Legal sign-off before processing.
nina_legal: Legal ok with a one-off credit provided we include a short concession letter with 'no future entitlement' language and customer acknowledgment. I'll draft the letter.
sam_revops: I ran the ingestion logs — duplicates came from retry path when the dedupe key was missing during a downtime window. Confirmed the excess billed units map to $12,400. Recommend full credit + postmortem + ops fix. +1 if Legal signs off.
irene_billingbot: Ticket BILL-4821 created and linked: https://redwood.ops/tickets/BILL-4821. Workflow: finance-credit -> ops-patch -> legal-concession -> am-ack.
jake_acct: AM asked for ETA for credit to reflect on their account. I told them ~3 business days after approvals.
leo_cfo: Approve one-off credit for $12,400. Condition: Legal concession letter signed by customer and AM confirms acceptance. @maria_finance please process credit and attach to April billing run.
maria_finance: Will process credit today, attach to April run, and add ledger note referencing BILL-4821. I'll upload the concession letter once Nina posts it. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
sam_revops: I'll add an alert to detect repeated hourly deltas >5% for the same customer within a 2-hour window and open a follow-up ops change.
